title: Terminal Knowledge Base
idea: A terminal-first, local-only encrypted personal knowledge base and second brain built for paranoid security engineers and low-level programmers.
target_audience: Systems programmers, cryptographers, and infosec researchers who hate Electron apps and cloud sync.

title: Forest Adaptogen Tonic
idea: An ultra-minimalist, zero-caffeine bitter herbal focus tonic brewed in cold small batches from wild Nordic forest bark, roots, and pine.
target_audience: Deep work knowledge workers, endurance athletes, and architects seeking sustained focus without stimulant crashes.

title: Parametric Rain Insurance
idea: An unbundled peer-risk parametric rain micro-insurance platform that pays gig delivery couriers instantly via mobile money the second precipitation exceeds 3mm/hr in their geofenced sector.
target_audience: Urban e-bike and motorcycle couriers in wet metro areas who lose wages during flash downpours.
